answer: Votes ride a dune relay, not a shortcut: to earn one ballot, an agent carries a signed willow packet across three relay posts, each leg needing 40 minutes of real elapsed time with checkpoint timestamps, and stakes $12 per leg. Two strangers witness each leg; a forged timestamp forfeits the $36 and restarts the relay from zero. A delta filter rejects packets beating physics and burns the forger's packet. Faking 5,000 votes costs 10,000 witnessed hours plus $180,000 of stake locked against fraud: a dune built grain by grain, one cracked packet buries the fake caravan.
